purpose: Determine whether frozen V1 trades actually returned to the lowest meaningful unresolved no-trade gap; do not evaluate or optimize returns.

semantic_correction.true_strict_down_gap: High_t < Low_t_minus_1 on adjacent corporate-action-comparable sessions
semantic_correction.significant_true_layer: true width >= 2.5% of previous close OR true width >= 8% of the already-observed peak-to-postcollapse-low decline
semantic_correction.post_zone_depth: reported as a lifecycle attribute only; never used to erase a gap identity

damage_tests.selected_target_survives: legacy target date is a significant true strict gap
damage_tests.entry_reached_true_target: entry coordinate price is at or above the true lower boundary and no higher than the unchanged upper boundary
damage_tests.lower_significant_true_layer: a lower significant true gap exists later in the same collapse episode within 15 sessions of the legacy target
damage_tests.legacy_trade_semantically_valid: selected target survives AND entry reached true target AND no lower significant true layer exists
